evidence.proof_scope: Exact-current-head CI verifies the Python connector-adapter runtime on Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.13, including explicit connector registration, fail-closed unavailable connectors, source-preserving merged results, adapter reuse and cleanup, unsupported-operation handling, local JSON/CSV/XML parsing, and the repository public-truth boundary. The same exact head also installs the locked Node dependency graph, executes the repository Jest suite, and compiles the TypeScript browser-provider/server source. This proof does not establish bundled or live Google Drive, Dropbox, Gmail, GitHub, OneDrive, MCP, APEX, Mastermind, Browserbase, Comet/CDP, Stagehand, or other provider connectivity; production browser execution; migrated or production Prisma persistence; autonomous external operational authority; production scale, reliability, latency, throughput, or security certification.
